claims.evidence: Photo 0 box printed with Nikon logo and model D750; Photo 1 printed manuals including User's Manual.
Photo 0 box and Photo 1 manual read Nikon D750, not D850.
Photos show packaging only; country of origin and prior use are not visible.
The actual camera body is not visible outside packaging.
Functional status such as power on or shutter count cannot be verified.

risks.risk: The camera body may not power on or may have hidden faults (shutter, sensor, mount).
risks.proof: Video clip of the D750 body turning on, navigating the menu, taking a shot, and a close-up of the body, sensor, and lens mount.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-working body / for parts only.

risks.risk: Actual shutter count and wear are unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of the camera info/menu screen showing shutter count.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as high-mileage or unknown wear.

risks.risk: Battery, charger, strap, and cables may be missing.
risks.proof: Close-up shot of all accessories unwrapped alongside the body.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as body only, no accessories.

risks.risk: The NIKKOR 50 lens box and Zhiyun gimbal box seen in the background may not be included.
risks.proof: Shot showing all items together with the seller confirming what is included in the sale.

risks.risk: No warranty or unknown purchase date (possible grey import).
risks.proof: Photo of the warranty card or original purchase receipt.

proof_requests: Video of the D750 body powered on, firing the shutter, and showing the sensor and lens mount.
Photo of the menu or info screen showing shutter count.
Close-up of all accessories (battery, charger, strap, cables) unwrapped.
Written confirmation whether the NIKKOR 50 lens and Zhiyun gimbal boxes are included.
Photo of the warranty card or purchase receipt.
response.reason: The witness identifies a Nikon D750 from the box and manual, so the item can be priced at its worst case even though the body itself is unseen and untested; the seller's D850 claim is contradicted and the condition claims are unproven.
